android.desc:
Track your portfolio, explore stock insights, and stay ahead with AI-powered news — all in one app.

Whether you’re just getting started or managing a growing portfolio, our platform gives you personalized, time-saving tools to make informed investing decisions quickly and confidently.

🔍 Features You’ll Love:
📊 Portfolio Tracking
See your holdings at a glance. Monitor gains/losses, sector exposure, and stay updated with relevant news tied to your portfolio.

📄 Stock Pages with AI Insights
Access clear summaries, bullish/bearish ratings, and interactive graphs for every stock — all powered by AI. No more digging through earnings reports.

📢 Breaking News Alerts
Get notified instantly when major events impact the market — earnings releases, Fed decisions, or global headlines.

📰 Curated Market Summaries
Save time with news condensed into concise, easy-to-read takeaways. Skip the noise, focus on what matters.

⭐ Personalized Watchlist News
Follow the stocks you care about. Your watchlist is constantly updated with relevant insights and alerts.

📈 Interactive Graphs
Turn complex numbers into visual clarity. Track revenue, margin trends, and other key financials through beautiful, intuitive charts.

⚡ Built for Retail Investors
This app is made for real investors — not hedge funds. If you're long-term focused, care about your time, and want clarity over clutter, this is for you.

💡 Why Investors Choose Us
• Unified view of stocks, insights, and news
• Clean design focused on speed and usability
• Real-time alerts & AI summaries you can trust
• Designed for modern investors, from beginner to intermediate

🔐 Private. Fast. Personalized.
We don’t flood you with charts or noise. Everything is tailored to your portfolio and watchlist. Insights are distilled. Charts are interactive. News is filtered. And your data stays private.

show_hn.title: Show HN: I built an app that streamlines financial news for everyday investors

quotes.text:
Hi HN, my friend Ivan and I are retail investors and consume financial news regularly. 
We both think the current finance news is unwatchable, filled with exaggerated titles, writer bias and anecdotal details, so we built MacroPulse to make the financial news app we want.

MacroPulse aggregates financial news, and the AI creates a single concise summary with key points for every stock daily. 
If you want to know the details, you can click the key points, the AI will give you extensive details. With the new format, I hope we can save you time while making you learn more about the details.

Download: IOS (https://apps.apple.com/hk/app/macropulse/id6741836726) & Android (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=co.macropulse.app)

We'd love to hear your thoughts and feedback! Thanks!
